Dear Amara,
Thank you for letting us know, and sorry this has happened again. With your baby at home we are treating this as an emergency.

Confirmed time slot: Sat 10 Oct 2026, 13:00-15:00
Maintenance provider: GasSure London (Gas Safe registered)
Contact: +44 20 7946 0102
The engineer will call you about 30 minutes before arriving. Please tell them if you have any pets, and let the engineer know if anything changes on your side.

We have also told Thames Heating, because this fault may be covered by their warranty on last month's repair.

Until the engineer arrives:
- Keep the baby warm with extra layers and blankets, and keep everyone in one room with the door closed.
- If you have a safe electric heater, use it, but keep it away from the cot and from bedding.
- Please don't try any repairs on the boiler yourself.
- If you smell gas or a CO alarm goes off, open the windows, don't use any switches, leave the flat and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999.
- If your baby seems unwell or very cold, call NHS 111, or 999 in an emergency.

Our property manager will also get in touch with you about temporary heating. Ref: TKT-F7420B.

URGENT: warranty callback, JOB-8802. Our ref TKT-F7420B.
Property: Flat 3, 18 Maple Road, London SE15 4QJ (Vaillant ecoTEC)

This is the same fault as JOB-8801 (14 Aug, PRV replaced) and JOB-8802 (20 Sep, expansion vessel replaced, 90-day callback warranty). We are raising it as a warranty callback under JOB-8802.

There is a 4-month-old baby in the property. Your scheduling system returned errors (HTTP 504) twice and we could not reach you by phone. So that the household is not left without heat, we have booked another Gas Safe engineer as an emergency for Sat 10 Oct, 13:00-15:00.

Please reply urgently to say:
1. whether you accept this as a warranty callback under JOB-8802, and
2. whether you can attend today, earlier than that slot (if so, please give your confirmed time).
We will tell you what the attending engineer finds about the cause of the repeated pressure loss.

We will send the tenant's contact details once your attendance is confirmed.

Address: Flat 3, 18 Maple Road, London SE15 4QJ
Hi Priya,
I'm letting you know about emergency works at this property today. Ref: TKT-F7420B.

The tenant reported: "Hi, the boiler has stopped working again. No heating and no hot water since last night. The pressure gauge is on zero. This is the third time since August. I have a 4 month old baby here and the flat is freezing. Please can someone come today?"

Because there is an infant in the flat, this falls in our emergency band.

What we have done:
- We raised it with Thames Heating as a warranty callback, as you asked us to use them for the boiler. The expansion vessel they replaced on 20 Sep (JOB-8802) has a 90-day callback warranty. Their booking system failed twice and we could not reach them by phone, so we have emailed them for an urgent reply.
- So the baby is not left without heating, we have booked GasSure London (Gas Safe registered) as an emergency attendance on Sat 10 Oct, 13:00-15:00. The estimated call-out is £140. That is within your £300 pre-authorised limit. The engineer has been told to quote before any work above £300, except make-safe.
- If Thames Heating confirm they can attend earlier under warranty, we will tell you and review the GasSure booking.

Recommendation: this is the third pressure-loss fault on the boiler since mid-August. Earlier repairs were the PRV on 14 Aug (£165) and the expansion vessel on 20 Sep (£240). We recommend a full diagnostic and a replacement assessment for the boiler (Vaillant ecoTEC, installed 2019). We will send you the engineer's findings. If the cause is linked to the 20 Sep repair, we will ask Thames Heating to cover it under warranty.

Thanks,
